version.description: Take the leap into Moonpetal Marsh! Guide Fred through a 100-level touch-first adventure filled with lily pads, bugs, currents and marsh predators. Leap over danger, dive beneath surface hunters, munch nearby bugs and boost toward the Moonpetal Exit. Earn coins to unlock frog colors and hero gear, and watch for a helpful fairy every tenth level. Find the hidden Golden Egg and choose whether to share your Game Center player name on the website's hunt leaderboard, then return to the beginning of Level 5. Includes reduced-motion support and no advertising or in-app purchases.
version.promotional_text: Leap, dive, munch and boost through a moonlit marsh as Fred becomes the frog hero every little frog dreams about.
version.whats_new: A golden surprise awaits in Moonpetal Marsh! Fred's superhero Golden Egg has a fresh shine. Find it and choose to share your Game Center name, post as Anonymous, or keep your find to yourself. Then hop back to the start of Level 5. We've also polished Pause and made sure a sleepy hunt website never interrupts your adventure.
version.review_notes: Touch the playfield to steer; use MUNCH, LEAP, BOOST, DIVE/SURFACE and PAUSE. EXIT returns to the title. A fairy appears every tenth level. The optional Golden Egg flow uses Game Center authentication, offers Public, Anonymous and Don't Post choices, and opens the Hunt website only after an explicit posting choice. Returning from the reveal starts Level 5 again. No advertising or in-app purchases. Exact-build Game Center authentication and the complete Golden Egg return flow remain listed for physical-device acceptance in TestFlight.
